<!-- Hashtag (categories tiap post) dengan jumlahnya; klik untuk menyaring.
     Diurutkan dari yang paling sering dipakai. Bila tag banyak, hanya 12 teratas yang tampil
     (tombol "+N more" untuk sisanya) dan muncul kotak pencarian tag.
     Link dari About berbentuk posts.html#category=<tag>. -->
<div class="post-tagbar" aria-label="Filter by hashtag"></div>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var TOP = 12;          // jumlah tag yang tampil sebelum "+N more"
    var SEARCH_FROM = 20;  // kotak pencarian tag muncul bila tag lebih dari ini
    var bar = document.querySelector(".post-tagbar");
    var counts = {};
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing [data-categories]").forEach(function (el) {
      decodeURIComponent(atob(el.dataset.categories)).split(",").forEach(function (t) {
        if (t) counts[t] = (counts[t] || 0) + 1;
      });
    });
    var tags = Object.keys(counts).sort(function (a, b) {
      return counts[b] - counts[a] || a.localeCompare(b);
    });
    function current() {
      var m = location.hash.match(/category=([^&]*)/);
      return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : "";
    }
    var expanded = false, query = "";

    function draw() {
      bar.innerHTML = "";
      if (tags.length > SEARCH_FROM) {
        var input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "search"; input.className = "tag-search"; input.placeholder = "Search tags…";
        input.value = query;
        input.addEventListener("input", function () {
          query = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
          draw();
          var again = bar.querySelector(".tag-search");
          again.focus(); again.setSelectionRange(again.value.length, again.value.length);
        });
        bar.appendChild(input);
      }
      var cur = current();
      var list = query ? tags.filter(function (t) { return t.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1; }) : tags;
      var shown = (expanded || query) ? list : list.slice(0, TOP);
      // tag yang sedang aktif tetap terlihat walau tidak termasuk 12 teratas
      if (cur && shown.indexOf(cur) === -1 && counts[cur]) shown = shown.concat([cur]);
      chip("All", "", document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing .list > *").length, cur === "");
      shown.forEach(function (t) { chip("#" + t, t, counts[t], t === cur); });
      if (!query && list.length > TOP) {
        var more = document.createElement("button");
        more.type = "button"; more.className = "news-tag tag-more";
        more.textContent = expanded ? "Show less" : "+" + (list.length - TOP) + " more";
        more.addEventListener("click", function () { expanded = !expanded; draw(); });
        bar.appendChild(more);
      }
    }
    function chip(label, tag, n, active) {
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button"; b.className = "news-tag" + (active ? " active" : "");
      b.dataset.tag = tag;
      b.innerHTML = label + ' <span class="news-tag-count">' + n + "</span>";
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!window.quartoListingCategory) return;
        window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(tag)));
        if (!tag) history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname);
        draw();
      });
      bar.appendChild(b);
    }
    draw();
  });
</script>
